process_observations.observation: Every element name and enum value emitted for all three types was available verbatim in the two cited skills' fenced XML; nothing had to be reached for outside the step's skills[].
Both declared checkers exited 0 on the first pass with no repair loop, and the one WARN raised is the sharing-bypass finding the plan's own test description predicted word for word.

The X-API-Key AuthHeader parameter ships with no parameterValue because two unknowns sit on top of each other: the formula grammar is marked UNVERIFIED in the cited skill, and the parameter name the key is stored under in Setup is named in no clarification, decision or step input.

The on-call tool's endpoint URL appears nowhere in requirement.md, the 45 clarifications or the step inputs, so the Url parameter ships a reserved-documentation-domain placeholder flagged in three places rather than a real host.

The permission set carries no license element; the skill requires that to be populated or empty by decision, and D14's assignee set (everyone who can escalate a Case plus the scheduling user) is not pinned to one license by any answer.

None of the three cited fenced examples for ExternalCredential, NamedCredential or PermissionSet carries a fullName element, so none was written; the step inputs name fullName values which source format carries in the file name instead.
The step's five acceptance tests include four automated ones this agent does not run.
process_observations.followup_reason: Because the step's checker, xml, manifest and manual tests are the tester's to execute and record, not the builder's.
